body.statement: For every \(\omega\in\mathcal U_{10^{-6}}\), the internally defined set \(\mathcal G(\omega)\) is a singleton and, for its unique element \(r\), \(L_\omega(r)>0.1964558>0.1845960>L_\omega(r_{\mathrm{alt}}(\omega))\), where \(r_{\mathrm{alt}}(\omega)=P_\omega(r_{\mathrm{alt}}^0)\in\mathcal R_B(\omega)\).
body.justification: An open-region theorem rules out the interpretation that separation is caused by one knife-edge rational law.
body.gap: No inspected result establishes an open neighborhood on which an internally specified pairwise-marginal-variance probe and the full correlated welfare-regret game have strictly separated optimizer values.
body.consumer: For CodiEtAl2025ClinicalRules and KimEtAl2025AzithromycinRules, prospective independent validation of the frozen ABCD azithromycin policy menu can use the internal \(G_\omega\) probe to diagnose whether a covariance summary retains enough joint information under small misspecification of stratum weights, budget, and arm-specific outcome variation. Neither cited paper is claimed to use or recommend \(G_\omega\).
